description:
Get current pricing and service tier details for MedicalRecords.com medical records retrieval services.

Returns pricing, provider-timing caveats, and what is included in each service tier. Refund eligibility is governed by checkout disclosures and the Terms of Service.

Note: In addition to MedicalRecords.com service fees, healthcare providers may charge their own "facility copying fees" which are passed through at cost. These vary by provider and state law.

Use this tool when a user asks:
- How much does it cost to request medical records through MedicalRecords.com?
- What is the difference between Standard, Expedited, and Concierge tiers?
- How long does it take to get medical records?
- Does MedicalRecords.com offer a money-back guarantee?

tier.description: Specific tier to retrieve. If omitted, returns all tiers.

name: get_pricing
